name: slack
description: Anthropic's official npm package @modelcontextprotocol/server-slack (MIT): list channels, post messages, read history. Requires a Slack bot token and team id.

metadata.install: No installation needed (npx fetches on demand)
metadata.env_hint: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN, SLACK_TEAM_ID (environment variables on the server process; do not put them in this JSON)
